chunks.text: Apex Home Services serves Seattle ZIP codes 98101 through 98105. We do not serve addresses outside those ZIP codes, and we ask callers to confirm their ZIP before scheduling.
Apex's business hours are Monday through Friday from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM. The office is closed on Sunday.
Heating repair covers furnaces, heat pumps, and boilers. A technician diagnoses the unit on site and explains the repair options before any work begins.
Cooling repair covers central air conditioners and ductless mini-splits. Seasonal tune-ups are recommended before the first hot spell of the year.
Apex does not publish prices for HVAC repair or any other service. A technician inspects the equipment and provides a written estimate that must be approved before work starts.
Repairs are covered by a one-year parts and labor warranty. Warranty service requires proof of the original appointment.
Appointments can be booked for the morning or afternoon window on any business day. Same-day emergency calls are accepted until noon when a truck is available.
Technicians carry proof of licensure and insurance. Carbon monoxide checks are included with every heating service visit.
Apex electricians handle wiring, panel upgrades, outlet and switch replacement, and lighting installation. Work is performed by licensed electricians.
Electrical service is available in Seattle ZIP codes 98101 through 98105, the same area our HVAC team covers.
Apex quotes electrical work after inspection. No price is published for panel work, rewiring, or lighting jobs.
Panel upgrades replace outdated service panels and are typically a multi-hour job requiring the utility to schedule an interruption.
Work passes inspection where the jurisdiction requires it. The permit process is handled by the technician and included in the quote.
Electrical appointments are booked through the same calendar as HVAC. Emergency outages are prioritized over routine work.
Plumbing services cover leak repair, drain cleaning, fixture replacement, and water heater work. Call before a leak becomes an emergency.
Plumbers from Apex serve Seattle ZIP codes 98101 through 98105 only. Bellevue and other Eastside cities are outside the service area.
A confirmed water leak is treated as urgent. The plumber isolates the supply, assesses the damage, and recommends repair or replacement.
Plumbing quotes are written after inspection and approved before work begins. Apex does not publish fixture or labor prices.
Water heater replacement includes removal of the old unit and installation of the new one. Tankless units require an electrical or gas assessment first.
Plumbing appointments share the main booking calendar and confirmations are sent the same way.
Window cleaning is $150 per hour with a two hour minimum. Exterior-only visits are priced the same; screens are cleaned at no extra charge.
Clearview Property Care serves Portland ZIP codes 97035 and 97201 through 97205.
Clearview works daily from 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM, including weekends, to fit commercial and residential schedules.
We clean interior and exterior glass where safe access allows, and we clean screens too, ending with a final inspection walk with the customer.
Commercial contracts receive quarterly cleaning schedules and a dedicated account contact. Invoice terms are net 30 for approved accounts.
Residential visits are scheduled in two hour blocks. A two hour minimum applies to every booking.
Cleaners use water-fed poles and squeegee kits. Ladders are used only under 20 feet; taller work is quoted separately with powered access.
Spring and fall are the busiest weeks for exterior work. Booking two weeks ahead in those seasons is recommended.
The HVAC diagnostic visit is $120. Repair work is quoted after inspection; replacement of major equipment is always quoted separately.
HVAC service is available in Portland ZIP codes 97035 and 97201 through 97205.
A diagnostic visit tests the system, reports the fault, and ends with a written repair estimate. The $120 fee is credited toward approved repairs.
The Care Plan covers two tune-ups per year and a 10 percent discount on repairs. Plans are billed annually.
HVAC appointments book into the same calendar as window cleaning, daily 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM.
Loss of heating in winter or loss of cooling in a heat event is treated as an emergency and moved ahead of routine appointments.
Clearview installs and services all major residential brands; no brand is preferred over another in recommendations.
The HVAC diagnostic visit was $95. This pricing sheet was replaced in 2026.
HVAC service previously covered only Portland 97201 through 97205. The coverage area was expanded in 2026.
The old maintenance plan covered one tune-up per year with no repair discount.
The electrical diagnostic visit is $140. Panel work and rewiring are quoted after inspection.
Electrical work is available in Portland ZIP codes 97035 and 97201 through 97205.
Licensed electricians handle wiring, panel upgrades, and outlet and switch replacement.
Electrical appointments share the daily 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM calendar.
Panel work passes jurisdiction inspection where required; the permit is handled by the technician.
